scope: SP01.2 proposed theorem obligations, not proofs

theorems.predicate: If StateWellTyped(sigma, Gamma) and Gamma |- e : tau and Eval(profile, e, sigma) = Prepared(sigma', pi), then StateWellTyped(sigma', Gamma) and Gamma |- e : tau. Expression type tau is not the type of sigma'. If Eval = Reject(r), then the post-state is absent and sigma is unchanged.

definitions.name: StateWellTyped
definitions.formula: StateWellTyped(sigma, Gamma) holds iff sigma is a finite record {accounts, debts, shares, fees, duties, requests, messages, orders, work, authority, historyIds, observations} and each field is well-typed in Gamma: accounts : FinMap(AccountId, FinMap(AssetId, Nat[0, M_a])); debts : FinMap(DebtId, {asset:AssetId, principal:Nat, debtor:AccountId, creditor:AccountId}); shares : FinMap(ShareId, {asset:AssetId, quantity:Nat, navUnits:Nat}); fees : FinMap(FeeId, {asset:AssetId, amount:Nat, recipient:AccountId}); duties : FinMap(DutyId, {kind:DutyKind, amount:Nat, asset:AssetId, controller:AccountId, residual:Bool}); requests, messages, orders similarly finite; work : {lifetime:Nat, spent:Nat, remainingOrdinary:Nat, remainingClosure:Nat} with spent + remainingOrdinary + remainingClosure = lifetime; authority : FinMap(PrincipalId, AllowedEffects); historyIds : FinSet(HistoryId); observations : FinSeq(Observation). No host heap. Nat[0, M_a] is the registered bound for asset a.

definitions.name: expression-type
definitions.formula: Gamma |- e : tau is the proposed typing judgement on programs/expressions. tau is an expression type (Plan, Intent, Observation, EffectSet). It is not assigned to a complete successor state.

definitions.name: Eval
definitions.formula: Eval(profile, e, sigma) in {Prepared(sigma', pi), Reject(r)} is the proposed successor evaluator. This map does not implement Eval. profile is a proposed local oracle profile, not a frozen language profile.

theorems.boundedDomain: finite named accounts, assets, duties, histories; registered per-asset M_a; work lifetime 1024; no unbounded collections
assumptions: proposed successor profile after SP01.3 freeze
StateWellTyped is distinct from expression typing

theorems.predicate: For every AssetId a, Sum_i post.accounts[i][a] - Sum_i pre.accounts[i][a] = minted(a) - burned(a). Internal transfers cancel. Fees are transfers to a named fee recipient and appear in the account sum. NominalDebt, ShareNAV, UnsettledPnL, LossLabel, and claim reclassification are not terms of this equation.

definitions.name: typed-asset-accounting-equation
definitions.formula: DeltaTokens(a) := Sum_{acct in AccountId} (post.bal(acct,a) - pre.bal(acct,a)) = minted(a) - burned(a), where minted, burned : AssetId -> Nat are the explicit mint and burn effects of the transition. For each transfer t in Transfers, t.asset = a implies t.from and t.to are AccountIds and t.amount in Nat, and the transfer contributes +amount to to and -amount to from, hence 0 to DeltaTokens(a).

definitions.name: AllowedEffects-accounting-subset
definitions.formula: Accounting effects are {Transfer(from,to,a,n), Mint(a,n,to), Burn(a,n,from), AccrueFee(from,recipient,a,n)}. AccrueFee is a Transfer. Non-token effects are {CreateDebt, ReduceDebt, AssignDuty, RecognizeLossLabel, AdjustShareNAV, CreateRequest, Claim, Lock, Unlock}.

definitions.name: nominal-vs-movement
definitions.formula: ReduceDebt(id, n) without a Transfer is forbidden unless n=0. RecognizeLossLabel(n) does not change accounts or erase Debt.principal. ShareNAV adjustment does not mint or burn share quantity unless an explicit Mint/Burn is present.

theorems.boundedDomain: finite asset index, finite accounts, amounts in Nat[0, M_a]
assumptions: bad-debt residual remains a duty unless authorized write-off/novation

theorems.predicate: Every accepted effect e satisfies e in AllowedEffects(envelope). Delegation yields AllowedEffects(delegate)subseteq AllowedEffects(parent). Split, cancel, and migrate do not increase remainingOrdinary, remainingClosure, or AllowedEffects cardinality. Revoked or unknown semantics reject with unchanged financial state.

definitions.name: AllowedEffects
definitions.formula: AllowedEffects(envelope) is the finite set of pairs (ctor, bound) signed in envelope. Constructors used in this map: Transfer, Mint, Burn, AccrueFee, CreateDebt, ReduceDebt, AssignDuty, RecognizeLossLabel, TradePortfolioAsset, PayFee, CancelResidual, Claim, Lock, Unlock, SendMessage, ReceiveMessage, RefundLock, WithdrawCash, RedeemOrdered, Swap, AddLiquidity, HookAdjustFee, WriteOff (authorized only). bound is a numeric cap or whitelist. e in AllowedEffects iff e.ctor is present and e.amount <= bound(ctor).

definitions.name: attenuation
definitions.formula: Delegate(parent, child, S) is valid iff S subseteq AllowedEffects(parent) and no ctor in {CreateDebt, GrantAuthority, ExternalRecipient} is added. Risk metrics of parent need not be preserved.

definitions.name: no-refresh
definitions.formula: On split of work W into W1, W2: W1.remainingOrdinary + W2.remainingOrdinary = W.remainingOrdinary, W1.remainingClosure + W2.remainingClosure = W.remainingClosure, and AllowedEffects are partitioned, not copied. Cancel and migrate obey the same sum, not a reset to envelope maxima.

theorems.boundedDomain: finite effect list, finite delegates, work lifetime 1024
assumptions: no LLM in the authority path

theorems.predicate: Let F = footprint.reads union footprint.writes. For every named resource r not in F, post(r) = pre(r). Unmentioned duties, debts, and accounts are unchanged. There is no ambient mutation.

definitions.name: bounded-frame
definitions.formula: A footprint is a pair (reads, writes) of finite lists of {resource: Name, capacity: Nat}. |reads| + |writes| <= maxCollectionSize (32). Name is drawn from the trace's actual accounts, debts, shares, requests, messages, ticks, positions, work cells, and authority cells. capacity is the max number of records touched.

definitions.name: frame
definitions.formula: Frame(sigma, F) = the restriction of sigma to names not in F. Frame-noninterference: Frame(pre, F) = Frame(post, F).

theorems.boundedDomain: finite named resources listed in each challenge boundedFootprint

theorems.predicate: If A sat GA under AsmA and B sat GB under AsmB and Compat_op(AsmA, AsmB, FP_A, FP_B, Auth_A, Auth_B), then (A op B) sat G_op(GA, GB) under (AsmA intersect AsmB) union OpAsm(op). If Compat_op fails, the composition Rejects with unchanged financial state.

definitions.name: compatibility
definitions.formula: Compat_sequential(A,B) iff producedHistories(A) = consumedHistories(B) and Auth_B subseteq residual(A). Compat_disjoint-parallel(A,B) iff (FP_A.writes intersect FP_B.writes = empty) and (FP_A.writes intersect FP_B.reads = empty) and (FP_B.writes intersect FP_A.reads = empty) and (Auth_A intersect Auth_B = empty). Compat_shared-state-interleaving(A,B) iff there exists an explicit total order Ord on conflicting writes and both parties agree on Ord. Compat_atomic-synchronization(A,B) iff there is a joint envelope E with AllowedEffects(E) = AllowedEffects(A) union AllowedEffects(B) and no external observable prefix of a proper subset of legs. Compat_asynchronous-messaging(A,B) iff the message alphabet, timeout, lock, refund, and provenance IDs are named in OpAsm(async).

definitions.name: guarantee-derivation
definitions.formula: G_sequential(GA,GB) = GA then GB on the concatenated history. G_disjoint-parallel(GA,GB) = GA and GB on the pair of histories. G_shared-state-interleaving(GA,GB) = the ordered composition along Ord, not GA and GB unordered. G_atomic-synchronization(GA,GB) = GA and GB on the joint post-state or else Reject all. G_asynchronous-messaging(GA,GB) = GA on send/lock and GB on receive-or-refund, never both credit and refund.

definitions.name: OpAsm
definitions.formula: OpAsm(op) is the finite assumption set of the operator contract in challenge-map.json compositionOperators[op].environmentAssumptions.

theorems.boundedDomain: finite components, the five registered operators, predecessorFanIn 4
assumptions: proof split/join is not an operator

theorems.predicate: For op in {sequential, disjoint-parallel}, ObsEq( (A op B) op C, A op (B op C) ) holds. For shared-state-interleaving, associativity holds only when OrderCond_shared is the same total order on all groupings. Atomic-synchronization associativity holds only for compatible joint envelopes. Asynchronous-messaging is not associative.

definitions.name: observation-equivalence
definitions.formula: ObsEq(o1, o2) iff there exists an alpha-renaming rho such that rho(o1.accounts, o1.transfers, o1.debts, o1.duties, o1.requests, o1.messages, o1.fees, o1.work.spent) equals the corresponding fields of o2, ignoring bound names in Bindable = {historyId, requestId, messageId, dutyId, claimId, stateId}.

definitions.name: alpha-renaming
definitions.formula: An alpha-renaming is a bijection rho : Bindable -> Bindable that is identity on free names (account ids that appear in the pre-state, asset ids, and signed principals). Substitution is capture-avoiding on bound history names.

definitions.name: observation-order
definitions.formula: OrderCond_sequential: observations concatenate. OrderCond_disjoint-parallel: observations of the two sides form a bag; no cross order. OrderCond_shared: the explicit serialization Ord is part of the observation; commuting Ord is not ObsEq. OrderCond_atomic: the only observations are pre and post of the joint envelope. OrderCond_async: Created < Pending < {Finalized, Refundable}; Finalized and Refunded are exclusive.

theorems.boundedDomain: finite operator trees of sequential or disjoint-parallel, or other operators only with the stated OrderCond

theorems.predicate: DutyConserv(pre, post, effects) holds for every accepted transition. Work exhaustion, cancel, and migrate do not delete duties. Expiry does not delete debt.

definitions.name: duty-conservation
definitions.formula: Let Out(sigma) be the finite map DutyId -> Duty of sigma.duties with residual=true. DutyConserv holds iff Out(post) = (Out(pre) minus Discharged) union Created, Discharged intersect Created = empty, and every d in Discharged has an effect in {SettleTransfer matching d.asset and d.amount, WriteOff(d) with ctor WriteOff in AllowedEffects, Novation(d, d') with d' in Created and exact-once assignment}. RecognizeLossLabel is not a discharge. CancelResidual discharges cancel-rights, not payment duties. Successor assignment requires identified S with S.remainingClosure >= minClosure (16 in defaultBounds) and no duplication of remainingOrdinary.

definitions.name: closure-reserve
definitions.formula: remainingClosure is a Nat reserved for discharge/successor work. Shutdown with Out nonempty and remainingClosure = 0 Rejects.

theorems.predicate: Conditional on the translation relation T defined below: if Admitted_D0(p0) and T(p, p0) and Eval_succ(p, sigma) = Prepared(sigma', pi) then Eval_P0(p0, sigma) = Prepared(sigma0, pi0) and D0Obs(pi) = D0Obs(pi0). This map does not claim that an implementation of T exists. Redesigned syntax (pre/next versus set/state) is outside T.

definitions.name: D0
definitions.formula: D0 is the already admitted atomic loan/swap program set retained by this map (atomicCoreRetention). A program p0 is in D0 iff it is an admitted loan or swap under the current atomic acceptance and uses only the existing atomic syntax. Admitted_D0(p0) is the existing acceptance predicate on that set. This map does not change those programs.

definitions.name: translation-relation-T
definitions.formula: T subseteq Programs_succ x Programs_D0 is the proposed partial relation: T(p, p0) holds iff p uses only the D0 loan/swap fragment (no successor-only constructors: pending-request, tick-walk, newton-D, async-message, vault-hook, loss-label, composition operators beyond atomic loan/swap) and p0 is the same program text read under profile P0. T is undefined for redesigned syntax. T is a mathematical relation, not an implemented translator.

definitions.name: D0Obs
definitions.formula: D0Obs(pi) is the projection of observations to {token transfers, loan principal, swap reserves, fees} used by current atomic acceptance.

assumptions: existing atomic acceptance is retained and not changed by this map
theorem is conditional on T as defined; T is not implemented in this pass
